name: bj-cross-border-withholding
description: Prepare a Benin domestic withholding schedule for dividends, ordinary interest and payments for foreign services or royalties in 2026. Use this Guide to establish recipient residence, permanent-establishment facts, treaty evidence, the correct gross base and the relevant payment, accounting-entry, expense or meeting event. It separates ordinary category rules from June-law retained-profit, capital-gain and rental-platform cases whose full calculations remain open. Two executable examples compare dividend classifications and separately invoiced mixed contracts. The output is a supported payment schedule for an authorised filer. It does not certify a treaty benefit, gross-up, completed declaration or accountant attestation. Trigger phrases include Benin withholding, nonresident royalties, interest accrual and foreign service payments.
